internal/vcstest TestRepoStates/gt flakes on macOS CI: TempDir cleanup races a gt background process

Seen 2026-08-28 on CI run 33196935577 (commit 0bd050d), macos-latest only; ubuntu-latest passed the same commit, and an unchanged rerun of the same job passed. So it is a flake, not a regression.

    --- FAIL: TestRepoStates (12.55s)
        --- FAIL: TestRepoStates/gt (5.34s)
            vcstest_test.go:712: fixture gt built in 2.74052275s
            testing.go:1464: TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat /var/folders/.../TestRepoStatesgt1520907742/001/home: directory not empty

The subtest body itself passes; the failure is `t.TempDir()`'s deferred RemoveAll. The gt case runs `gt state` (vcstest_test.go:701) against a fixture whose HOME is under the temp dir. Graphite writes into HOME and evidently keeps something alive — or writes asynchronously — past the test body's return, so RemoveAll races it and finds `home` non-empty. macOS-only so far, consistent with a timing race rather than a logic error.

Worth fixing rather than tolerating: it reddens CI on unrelated commits, and a red run that is actually a flake trains people to re-run instead of read. Likely fix is for the fixture to wait for, or explicitly terminate, whatever gt leaves running before the test returns, rather than relying on RemoveAll winning the race.

Not investigated further: which gt process holds it, and whether a `gt` cache/telemetry setting can keep it out of HOME entirely.
